blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential as training-free text encoders for long-context embeddings.
Existing approaches primarily improve information flow under causal attention and typically construct embeddings by uniformly averaging all token representations. However, for long documents, such mean pooling can dilute salient semantic information with abundant redundant or weakly informative content.
To this end, we propose SCSP, a training-free framework that leverages semantic compression for informative token selection in long-context embedding.
Specifically, SCSP first partitions a document into sentence-aware chunks and appends a semantic compression prompt to each chunk.
A prompt-isolated attention mask preserves information flow among document tokens while restricting each prompt to its corresponding local context.
We then use the attention patterns elicited by these prompts to estimate token importance, select informative tokens, and aggregate their intermediate-layer representations into the final embedding.
Extensive experiments on long-context embedding benchmarks demonstrate that SCSP can be integrated into both zero-shot and fine-tuned models in a plug-and-play manner, consistently improving their performance.
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型(LLMs)已经显示出作为长文本嵌入的无培训文本编码器的强大潜力.
现有办法主要改善因果关注下的信息流动,通常通过统一平均所有象征性表示来构建嵌入。 然而,对于冗长的文件来说,这种集合意味着可以淡化大量冗余或信息不足的显著语义信息。
为此,我们提议使用无培训框架SCSP,利用语义压缩在长文本嵌入中选择信息符号。
具体地说,SCSP首先将一个文档分割成句子感知块,并在每个块中附加一个语义压缩提示.
迅速同化的注意遮罩保持了文件符号之间的信息流动,同时将每个提示限制在相应的本地上下文。
然后,我们利用这些提示所产生的注意模式来估计象征性的重要性,选择信息化的符号,并将其中间层的表示综合到最后嵌入中。
关于长文本嵌入基准的广泛实验表明,SCSP可以以插件和游戏方式融入零镜头和微调模型,不断提高它们的性能.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Text embeddings have a wide range of real-world applications, including information retrieval, text clustering, and recommender systems.
Recently, motivated by the strong long-context modeling and zero-shot generalization capabilities of large language models (LLMs), several studies ( Ding et al., 2026 ; Fu et al., 2025 ) have explored directly extracting long-context embeddings from LLMs without additional parameter updates.
This training-free paradigm avoids the computational cost of fine-tuning while preserving the original generative capabilities of LLMs, making off-the-shelf models readily applicable as text encoders.
blocks.zh:
文本嵌入具有广泛的现实世界应用,包括信息检索,文本集群,以及推荐者系统.
最近,在大语言模型(LLMs)强大的长文本模型化和零镜头通用能力的推动下,一些研究(Ding等人,2026年;Fu等人,2025年)探索直接从LLMs中提取长文本嵌入,而没有额外的参数更新.
这种无培训模式避免了微调的计算成本,同时保留了LLMs的原始基因能力,使得现成的模型很容易作为文本编码器应用.

blocks.en:
Existing training-free methods improve LLM-based text embeddings by introducing backward dependencies under causal attention, allowing earlier tokens to incorporate information from subsequent positions.
Echo ( Springer et al., 2025 ) achieves this by repeating the input sequence and extracting representations from its second occurrence.
To avoid the computational overhead of input repetition, Token Prepending (TP) ( Fu et al., 2025 ) places a global semantic representation at the beginning of the input sequence.
Hierarchical Token Prepending (HTP) ( Ding et al., 2026 ) further introduces multiple block-level representations, alleviating the information bottleneck caused by compressing the entire document into a single global token.
blocks.zh:
现有的无培训方法通过在因果关注下引入落后的依赖性,使早期的代号能够包含来自后续位置的信息,从而改进基于LLM的文本嵌入.
Echo(Springer等人,2025年)通过重复输入序列和从第二次出现中提取表达来实现这一目标.
为了避免输入重复的计算间接费用,Token Preday(TP)(Fu等人,2025年)在输入序列的开头放置了全球语义代表.
等级Token PreKY (HTP)(Ding等人, 2026年)进一步引入了多个区块级的表示,缓解了将整个文档压缩成一个单一的全球符号而导致的信息瓶颈.

blocks.en:
Although existing methods improve how token representations incorporate global or backward context, they largely overlook the final semantic aggregation step.
In particular, mean pooling is commonly adopted and has been shown to outperform last-token pooling for long-context embeddings ( Ding et al., 2026 ) .
However, mean pooling implicitly assigns equal importance to all tokens, even though long documents often contain substantial amounts of semantically redundant or uninformative content.
Consequently, uniformly averaging all token representations may dilute the contribution of salient tokens, causing critical semantic information to be overwhelmed by less informative content ( Doshi et al., 2026 ) .
This observation motivates the following research question: Can we identify and selectively aggregate informative tokens, rather than treating all tokens equally, to construct long-context embeddings without additional training?
blocks.zh:
虽然现有方法改进了象征性表述如何纳入全球或落后背景,但它们在很大程度上忽略了最后语义汇总步骤。
特别是,通常采用 " 平均集合 " (Ding等人,2026年)。
然而,即使冗长的文件往往含有大量内容,内容过于繁琐或内容不灵通,但集中意味着对所有符号都具有同等的重要性。
因此,统一平均所有象征性表示可能削弱显著表示的贡献,使重要语义信息被信息较少的内容所压倒(Doshi等人,2026年)。
这一观察提出了以下研究问题: 我们能否确定并有选择地汇总信息符号,而不是平等对待所有符号,在没有额外培训的情况下构建长文本嵌入?

blocks.en:
To answer this question, we propose a training-free Semantic Compression-guided Selective Pooling (SCSP) method for long-context embedding.
Instead of treating all token representations uniformly, SCSP exploits the attention patterns elicited by semantic compression prompts as intrinsic signals of token importance.
Specifically, we partition a long document into sentence-aware chunks and append a semantic compression prompt to each chunk, enabling token importance to be estimated within focused and semantically coherent local contexts.
A prompt-isolated attention mask further prevents the inserted prompts from interfering with the original document representations while restricting each prompt to its corresponding chunk.
Based on the resulting attention distributions, SCSP selects semantically informative tokens and aggregates their representations to construct the final long-context embedding.
Extensive experiments across multiple long-context embedding benchmarks demonstrate that SCSP consistently improves existing training-free approaches and can be seamlessly integrated into fine-tuned embedding models, highlighting the general effectiveness of selective semantic aggregation.
blocks.zh:
为了回答这个问题,我们提议一种无训练的语义压缩-导引选择性集合(SCSP)方法,用于长文嵌入.
SCSP没有统一对待所有符号表示,而是将语义压缩提示所引发的注意模式作为象征重要性的内在信号加以利用。
具体地说,我们把一个长的文件分割成句子感知块,并在每个块上附加一个语义压缩提示,以便能够在有重点和连贯的地方范围内估计象征性的重要性。
迅速隔离的注意会进一步防止插入的提示干扰原始文件的表述,同时将每个提示限制在相应的块内。
根据由此产生的关注分布,SCSP选择了内容翔实的符号,并汇总了它们的表示来构建最终的长文嵌入.
跨越多个长文嵌入基准的广泛实验表明,SCSP一贯改进现有的无培训方法,可以无缝地融入微调嵌入模型,突出选择性语义聚合的一般有效性.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We revisit the final aggregation step in long-context embedding extraction and show that selectively pooling informative tokens is more effective than uniformly averaging all tokens. • We propose SCSP, a training-free selective pooling framework that leverages attention elicited by local semantic compression as an intrinsic signal of token importance, enabling informative tokens to be identified and aggregated. • Extensive experiments across multiple long-context embedding benchmarks show that SCSP consistently improves diverse training-free baselines and further enhances fine-tuned embedding models, demonstrating the broad applicability of selective semantic aggregation.
blocks.zh: • 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 我们重新审视在长文嵌入提取中的最后汇总步骤,并表明有选择地汇集信息符号比统一平均所有符号更有效。 我们提议建立无培训选择性集合框架,利用当地语义压缩所产生的注意力,作为象征重要性的内在信号,从而能够确定和汇总信息符号。 • 多种长文嵌入基准的广泛实验表明,SCSP一贯改进各种无培训基线,并进一步加强微调嵌入模型,表明选择性语义聚合的广泛适用性。

blocks.en: We revisit the final aggregation step in long-context embedding extraction and show that selectively pooling informative tokens is more effective than uniformly averaging all tokens.
blocks.zh: 我们重新审视在长文嵌入提取中的最后汇总步骤,并表明有选择地汇集信息化的符号比统一平均所有符号更有效。

blocks.en: We propose SCSP, a training-free selective pooling framework that leverages attention elicited by local semantic compression as an intrinsic signal of token importance, enabling informative tokens to be identified and aggregated.
blocks.zh: 我们提议建立无培训选择性集合框架,利用当地语义压缩所产生的注意力,作为象征重要性的内在信号,从而能够确定和汇总信息符号。

blocks.en: Extensive experiments across multiple long-context embedding benchmarks show that SCSP consistently improves diverse training-free baselines and further enhances fine-tuned embedding models, demonstrating the broad applicability of selective semantic aggregation.
blocks.zh: 跨越多个长文嵌入基准的广泛实验表明,SCSP一贯改进各种无培训基线,并进一步加强精细化嵌入模型,表明选择性语义聚合的广泛适用性.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Text embedding models map variable-length texts into fixed-dimensional vectors and serve as fundamental components in information retrieval, clustering, and semantic text similarity.
Early neural text encoders, such as Sentence-BERT ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ) and SimCSE ( Gao et al., 2021 ) , typically relied on metric learning to acquire semantic representations.
Recent studies ( BehnamGhader et al., 2024 ; Li and Li, 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) increasingly utilize LLMs as text encoders, leveraging the semantic knowledge acquired during generative pretraining.
For example, LLM2Vec ( BehnamGhader et al., 2024 ) converts LLMs into bidirectional encoders by removing the causal attention mask and subsequently applying masked next-token prediction and contrastive learning.
In addition, several studies ( Günther et al., 2023 ; Saad-Falcon et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024b ; Doshi et al., 2026 ) have focused on long-context embedding models.
However, these methods require large amounts of data and incur substantial fine-tuning costs, while also turning general-purpose LLMs into specialized embedding models.
blocks.zh:
文本嵌入模型将可变长文本映射成固定维向量,并作为信息检索,集群,语义文本相似性的基本组成部分.
早期神经文字编码器,如Priment-BERT(Reimers and Gurevych, 2019)和SimCSE(Gao et al, 2021),通常依靠测量学来获得语义表达.
最近的研究(BehnamGhader等人,2024年;Li和Li,2024年;Lee等人,2025年)越来越多地利用LLMs作为文本编码器,利用在基因预训期间获得的语义知识。
例如,LLM2Vec(Behnam) Ghader等人,2024年)转换 LLMs通过去掉因果关注罩,然后应用蒙面的下位子预测和对比性学习,进入双向编码器.
此外,一些研究(Günther等人,2023年;Saad-Falcon等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2024年b;Doshi等人,2026年)侧重于长文嵌入模型.
然而,这些方法需要大量数据,并产生大量微调费用,同时将通用有限责任公司转变为专门嵌入模型。

blocks.en:
Motivated by the strong zero-shot capabilities of LLMs, recent studies ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2025 ; Springer et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Ding et al., 2026 ) have begun to repurpose off-the-shelf LLMs as text encoders.
One line of work ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; Lei et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024a ; Thirukovalluru and Dhingra, 2025 ) focuses on prompt engineering to elicit higher-quality text representations from LLMs.
A representative method, PromptEOL ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) , introduces a semantic compression prompt, This sentence: “ [TEXT] ” means in one word: “ , which encourages the model to compress the semantics of the input text into the representation of the final token.
Another line of work focuses on introducing backward dependencies into LLMs to overcome the limitations of causal attention.
Echo ( Springer et al., 2025 ) repeats the input sequence, allowing the second occurrence to attend to the entire text.
Token Prepending (TP) ( Fu et al., 2025 ) prepends a global semantic representation to the input sequence, while Hierarchical Token Prepending (HTP) ( Ding et al., 2026 ) further introduces multiple block-level semantic representations and shows that mean pooling is more effective than last-token pooling for long-context embeddings.
Different from these approaches, our method focuses on long-context embeddings and uses the attention patterns elicited by semantic compression prompts to estimate token importance and selectively aggregate informative token representations.
blocks.zh:
受LLMS强大的零射能力驱动,近期研究(Jiang等人,2024年;Cheng等人,2025年;Springer等人,2025年;Fu等人,2025年;Ding等人,2026年)开始将LLMs作为文本编码器重新使用。
一行工作(Jiang et al.,2024;Lei et al.,2024;Zhang et al.,2024a;Thirukovalluru and Dhingra,2025)侧重于快速工程,以吸引LLMs的高质量文本表述.
一种具有代表性的方法,PournalEOL(Jiang等人,2024年),引入了语义压缩速率, 这句话:“[TEXT]”用一个词表示:“,这鼓励模型将输入文本的语义压缩为表示最终符号。
另一类工作的重点是将落后依赖性引入法学硕士课程,以克服因果关注的局限性。
Echo(Springer et al., 2025)重复输入序列,允许第二次出现关注整个文本.
Token Prechy(TP)(Fu等人,2025年)预先将一个全局语义表达到输入序列上,而Hierarchical Token Prechy(HTP)(Ding等人,2026年)进一步引入了多个块级语义表达,并显示,对长文嵌入来说,"平均集合"比最后的托肯集合更有效.
与这些方法不同,我们的方法侧重于长文字嵌入,并使用语义压缩提示引发的注意规律来估计象征性的重要性,并有选择地汇总信息性符号表示.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en:
The key idea of our method is to leverage chunk-wise semantic compression prompts to identify informative tokens for long-context embedding construction.
As illustrated in Figure 1 , our framework consists of four main components: input construction, prompt-isolated attention mask, semantic compression-guided token selection, and intermediate-layer selective pooling.
blocks.zh:
我们方法的关键思想是利用块形语义压缩提示,为长文本嵌入构造确定信息符号。
如图1所示,我们的框架由四个主要部分组成:输入构造、迅速同位化的注意力罩、语义压缩制导的符号选择和中间层选择性集合。

blocks.en:
Given a long document, we first partition it into multiple local sentence-aware chunks and append a semantic compression prompt to each chunk.
Then, we modify the attention mask to prevent subsequent document tokens from attending to the semantic compression prompts, while restricting each prompt to attend only to tokens within its corresponding chunk.
Subsequently, we use the attention distributions elicited by the semantic compression prompts to estimate token importance and select informative tokens.
Finally, we aggregate the representations of all selected tokens from an intermediate layer to obtain the final long-context embedding.
blocks.zh:
由于文档很长,我们首先将其分割成多个局部的句子感应块,并在每个块上附加一个语义压缩提示.
然后,我们修改注意面罩,防止随后的文档符号去注意语义压缩提示,同时将每个提示限制在相应的块内只注意符号.
随后,我们利用语义压缩提示引发的注意分布来估计符号重要性,并选择信息符号.
最后,我们从中间层汇总所有选定符号的表示,以获得最终的长文本嵌入。

blocks.en: 3.2 Input Construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 投入建设

blocks.en:
Instead of estimating token importance over an entire long document, we first partition the input into multiple local contexts.
By reducing the semantic scope associated with each compression prompt, this partitioning enables more reliable estimation of token importance within a semantically coherent context.
blocks.zh:
我们没有估计整个长文件的象征性重要性,而是首先将投入分为多个地方背景。
通过减少与每个压缩速率相关的语义范围,这种分割使得能够在一个整体一致的背景下更可靠地估计象征性的重要性。

blocks.en:
Given an input text sequence T = [ t 1 , ⋯ , t n ] T=[t_{1},\cdots,t_{n}] , we partition it into M M non-overlapping sentence-aware chunks T = [ C 1 , ⋯ , C M ] T=[C_{1},\cdots,C_{M}] .
Each chunk consists of several complete sentences and is constrained to contain no more than X X tokens, where X X denotes the maximum chunk size.
This sentence-level partitioning preserves semantic coherence within each chunk and prevents the semantic information of a sentence from being divided across different chunks.
blocks.zh:
考虑到输入文本序列 T = [t 1, ⋯, t n] T = [t_{1],\cdots, t_{n}],我们将其分割为 M M 不重叠的句子-意识块 T = [C 1, ⋯, C M] T = [C_{1],\cdots, C_{M].
每个块由数个完整的句子组成,并被限制包含不超过X X 符号,其中X X表示最大块大小.
这种句子级别分隔法保留了每个块内的语义一致性,防止句子的语义信息被划分为不同的块.

blocks.en:
After partitioning the input into chunks, we augment each chunk by appending a short semantic compression prompt, P = Brief summary P=\texttt{Brief summary} : “, to its end, inspired by PromptEOL ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) .
The prompt elicits the LLM’s intrinsic semantic compression capability, producing attention patterns that reflect the semantic importance of tokens within each local context.
In particular, the trailing colon and opening quotation mark in the prompt are used to prevent the model from generating punctuation as the next token, thereby enabling more effective semantic compression.
blocks.zh:
在将输入分为块之后,我们通过附加一个简短的语义压缩提示来增加每个块,P = 简略摘要 P =\textt{Brief摘要} : “ 在其末尾,灵感来自ExponyEOL(Jiang等人,2024年)。
提示会引出LLM的内在语义压缩能力,产生能反映每个本地背景中符号的语义重要性的注意模式.
特别是,提示符中的尾号和开口引号被用来防止该模型生成标点符号作为下一个符号,从而能够更有效地进行语义压缩.

blocks.en:
Finally, the resulting augmented input sequence is given by T ^ = [ C 1 , P 1 , C 2 , P 2 , ⋯ , C M , P M ] . \hat{T}=[C_{1},P_{1},C_{2},P_{2},\cdots,C_{M},P_{M}]. Notably, chunking is used solely to determine where to insert the semantic compression prompts.
We still feed the entire augmented input sequence into the LLM at once, rather than processing each chunk separately.
blocks.zh:
最后,产生的增量输入序列由 T ^ = [C 1, P 1, C 2, P 2, + , + , C M, P M] 给出.\ hat{T} [C_{1}, P_{1}, C_{2}, P_{2},\cdots, C_{M}, P_{M}]. 值得注意的是,块化仅用于确定插入语义压缩提示的位置.
我们仍然将整个增强的输入序列同时输入LLM,而不是分别处理每个块.

blocks.en: 3.3 Prompt-Isolated Attention Mask
blocks.zh: 3.3 快速隔离的注意力罩

blocks.en: After constructing the input, we modify the attention mask to prevent the semantic compression prompts from interfering with the original tokens in the long document and to restrict the attention scope of each prompt.
blocks.zh: 在构建输入后,我们修改了注意面罩,以防止语义压缩提示干扰长文档中的原始符号,并限制每个提示的注意范围.

blocks.en:
For the original document tokens, we preserve causal attention among all preceding document tokens while masking out all inserted prompt tokens.
Consequently, the document is still processed jointly as a whole, allowing information to propagate across chunk boundaries, while the inserted prompts do not directly affect the representations of the original document tokens through attention.
For the prompt appended to chunk C i C_{i} , we restrict its attention to the tokens in C i C_{i} and the preceding tokens within the prompt itself.
Although each prompt directly attends only to its corresponding chunk, the document tokens themselves retain causal dependencies across chunk boundaries.
Therefore, each prompt serves as a local semantic readout over globally contextualized token representations.
blocks.zh:
对于原始文件代号,我们保留所有先前文件代号的因果注意,同时掩盖所有插入的即时代号。
因此,该文件仍然作为一个整体进行联合处理,允许信息跨越块边界传播,而插入的提示不会通过注意直接影响原始文件符号的表示。

因此,每个提示都是一种针对全球背景化符号表示的当地语义读取。

Formally, let 𝒟 \mathcal{D} denote the positions of the original document tokens, 𝒞 i \mathcal{C}_{i} denote the positions of the tokens in chunk C i C_{i} , and 𝒫 i \mathcal{P}_{i} denote the positions of the prompt appended to C i C_{i} . The modified attention mask matrix 𝐌 \mathbf{M} is defined as M q , k = { 0 , q ∈ 𝒟 , k ∈ 𝒟 , k ≤ q , 0 , q ∈ 𝒫 i , k ∈ 𝒞 i , 0 , q ∈ 𝒫 i , k ∈ 𝒫 i , k ≤ q , − ∞ , otherwise . M_{q,k}=\begin{cases}0,&q\in\mathcal{D},\ k\in\mathcal{D},\ k\leq q,\\
0,&q\in\mathcal{P}_{i},\ k\in\mathcal{C}_{i},\\
0,&q\in\mathcal{P}_{i},\ k\in\mathcal{P}_{i},\ k\leq q,\\
-\infty,&\text{otherwise}.\end{cases} This design prevents information from the inserted prompts from directly propagating into the document token representations through attention, while constraining each prompt to estimate token importance within a localized semantic context.
Notably, we also explore modifying the positional encodings to keep the position indices of the original document tokens contiguous.
In this way, each document token preserves the same representation as in the unaugmented input.
However, this strategy does not yield any performance improvement.

blocks.en: 3.4 Semantic Compression-Guided Token Selection
blocks.zh: 3.4 语义压缩-定向托肯选择

blocks.en:
After constructing the prompt-augmented input and applying the modified attention mask, we use the attention patterns induced by the semantic compression prompts to identify informative tokens.
The intuition is that semantic compression requires the model to focus on the most informative content within each chunk, which is reflected in the attention assigned to individual tokens.
We therefore use the attention weights produced by each semantic compression prompt as estimates of token importance.
blocks.zh:
在构建即时增强的输入并应用修改后的注意面具后,我们利用语义压缩提示引发的注意模式来识别信息符号.
直觉是,语义压缩需要模型将注意力集中在每个块内最丰富的内容上,这反映在对单个符号的注意上.
因此,我们使用每个语义压缩速率所产生的注意力权重作为象征性重要性的估计。

blocks.en:
For each chunk C i C_{i} , let p i p_{i} denote the position of the final token in its appended prompt.
Under the modified attention mask, the token at position p i p_{i} can attend only to the original tokens in C i C_{i} and the preceding tokens within its own prompt.
Given the normalized self-attention score matrix 𝐀 ( ℓ , h ) \mathbf{A}^{(\ell,h)} of the h h -th attention head in the ℓ \ell -th Transformer layer, we define the importance score of token t j ∈ C i t_{j}\in C_{i} as s i , j = max ℓ = 1 , … , L ⁡ max h = 1 , … , H ​ A p i , j ( ℓ , h ) , s_{i,j}=\max_{\ell=1,\ldots,L}\max_{h=1,\ldots,H}A^{(\ell,h)}_{p_{i},j}, where L L and H H denote the numbers of Transformer layers and attention heads, respectively.
We take the maximum across layers and attention heads so that a strong semantic association captured by an individual layer or head can contribute to token selection.
Notably, since the normalized attention scores are used solely for token selection within each chunk, the attention assigned to the semantic compression prompt itself is excluded when normalizing the attention scores over the chunk.
blocks.zh:
对于每个块 C i C_{i}, 让 p i p_{i} 在后面的提示中表示最后符号的位置 。
在经过修改的注意面罩下,p i p_{i}位置的令牌只能到C i C_{i}中的原始令牌和前面的令牌在自己的提示内出席.

值得注意的是,由于正常的注意分数只用于每个块内的符号选择,在将注意分数正常化于块上时,分配给语义压缩的注意本身被排除.

blocks.en: 3.5 Intermediate-Layer Selective Pooling
blocks.zh: 3.5 中级-莱尔选择性集合

blocks.en: Since final-layer representations are primarily optimized for next-token prediction, while intermediate layers tend to preserve richer semantic information ( Fu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) , we use an intermediate layer as the output layer to extract token representations and aggregate them into the final long-context embedding.
blocks.zh: 由于最终层的表达方式主要是优化用于下位的预测,而中间层则倾向于保存更丰富的语义信息(Fu等人,2025年;Liu等人,2024年),因此我们使用中间层作为输出层来提取符号表达方式并将其聚合到最终的长文嵌入中.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets and Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate the performance of long-context embeddings on five real-world datasets from LongBench ( Bai et al., 2024 ) and LongEmbed ( Zhu et al., 2024 ) : QMSum ( Zhong et al., 2021 ) , 2WikiMultiHopQA ( Ho et al., 2020 ) , SummScreenFD ( Chen et al., 2022 ) , NarrativeQA ( Kociský et al., 2018 ) , and MultiFieldQA ( Bai et al., 2024 ) .
We use nDCG@10 as the evaluation metric.
blocks.zh:
我们评价长文嵌入来自龙本奇(Bai等人,2024年)和长恩贝德(Zhu等人,2024年)的五个真实世界数据集上的长文的性能:QMSum( Zh等人,2021年),2Wiki MultiHopQA(Ho等人,2020年),SummScreenFD (Chen等人,2022年),NarrativeQA(Kociský等人,2018年),和多场QA(Bai等人,2024年).
我们使用nDCG@10作为评价尺度。

blocks.en:
We conduct all experiments using 4 NVIDIA Tesla V100 GPUs.
We use Spacy’s parser to split the text into sentences.
We primarily evaluate LLaMA3.1-8B-Instruct ( Dubey et al., 2024 ) and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) with context lengths of 512 and 8,192 tokens.
For a context length of 512, we set the chunk size to 256 and perform a grid search over the ratio values α \alpha in { 1 , 1.25 , 1.5 , 1.75 , 2 } \{1,1.25,1.5,1.75,2\} .
For a context length of 8,192, we set the chunk size to 512 and search α \alpha over { 1.5 , 1.75 , 2 , 2.25 , 2.5 } \{1.5,1.75,2,2.25,2.5\} .
For Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 , following HTP ( Ding et al., 2026 ) , we use the third-to-last layer as the output layer.
For LLaMA3.1-8B-Instruct , we search for the optimal output layer among the final seven layers.
blocks.zh:
我们使用4个NVIDIA Tesla V100 GPU进行所有实验.
我们用斯佩西的解析器将文字分成句子.
我们主要评价LLaMA3.1-8B-Instruct(Dubey等人,2024年)和Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3(Jiang等人,2023年),其上下文长度为512和8,192个令牌.
上下文长度为 512, 我们设定块大小为 256, 并在 { 1, 1. 25, 1. 5, 1. 75, 2} { 1, 1. 25, 1. 15, 1. 175, 2} 的比例值上进行网格搜索 。
上下文长度为8,192,我们把块大小设定为512,在 { 1.5, 1.75, 2, 2.25, 2.5 } {1.5, 1.75, 2,2.25, 2.5 } 上下文搜索 α\ alpha。
用于Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3,如下 HTP(丁等人,2026年),我们使用第三层到最后一层作为输出层.
对于LLaMA3.1-8B-Instruct,我们寻找最后七层中的最佳输出层.

blocks.en: 4.2 Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.2 基线

blocks.en:
We compare our method with the following baselines. PromptEOL ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) compresses the semantics of a text into the last token to extract embeddings. TP ( Fu et al., 2025 ) prepends a global semantic token to the beginning of the input.
For TP, we also explore two embedding extraction strategies: TP w. PromptEOL , which uses last-token pooling, and TP w. Mean , which uses mean pooling. Vanilla Mean directly applies mean pooling over the hidden states of all tokens produced by the LLM. Echo Mean ( Springer et al., 2025 ) repeats the text twice and uses mean-pooling to extract embeddings from the second occurrence. HTP ( Ding et al., 2026 ) extends TP by introducing multiple block-level representations, and constructs the final embedding through mean pooling over all token representations.
In particular, to ensure a fair comparison, all baseline methods use the same output layer for representation extraction.
blocks.zh:
我们的方法与以下基线相比较。 PourneEOL (Jiang et al., 2024) 将文本的语义压缩为最后一个符号以提取嵌入. TP(Fu等人,2025年)在输入开始前先使用一个全球语义符号.
对于TP,我们还探索两种嵌入式提取策略: TP w. ExpressEOL(使用最后的托肯集合)和 TP w. 平面,就是用平面 香草 平均直接应用是指集合在LLM生产的所有令牌的隐藏状态上. 回声平均值 (Springer等人,2025年)重复文字两次,并使用平均集合法从第二次发生中提取嵌入物. HTP(Ding et al., 2026)通过引入多个区块级的表示来扩展TP,并通过在所有符号表示上的平均集合来构建最终嵌入.
特别是,为了确保公平比较,所有基线方法都使用相同的产出层进行代表提取。

blocks.en: 4.3 Results
blocks.zh: 4.3 结果

blocks.en:
As shown in Tables 1 and 2 , our method consistently improves the performance of Vanilla Mean, Echo Mean, and HTP across both Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 and LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct models.
These results demonstrate that our method is effective and can be seamlessly integrated with baselines in a plug-and-play manner.
Using LLaMA with a context length of 8,192, combining our method with Echo Mean improves the average performance by 60% relative to Echo Mean alone.
Notably, when combined with our method, the simplest Vanilla Mean achieves the best performance on Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 at a context length of 8,192.
blocks.zh:
如表1和表2所示,我们的方法在Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3和LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct模型中,都不断改进了Vanilla Mean、Echo Mean和HTP的性能。
这些结果显示,我们的方法是有效的,可以以插座和游戏的方式与基线无缝结合。
使用 LLa 软件 MA的上下文长度为8,192,结合我们的方法和Echo Mean,平均性能比Echo Mean提高60%。
值得注意的是,最简单的Vanilla Mean结合我们的方法,在Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3上以8 192的上下文长度实现了最佳性能。

blocks.en:
At a context length of 512, Echo Mean serves as a strong baseline because input repetition enhances the model’s contextual understanding. Our method is complementary to Echo Mean and further improves its performance.
At a context length of 8,192, Echo Mean generally fails to yield performance improvements, possibly because the context becomes excessively long.
In contrast, our method achieves larger gains in this setting, likely because selectively preserving salient semantic information becomes increasingly important as the context length grows.
blocks.zh:
上下文长度为512, " Echo Mean " 是一个强有力的基线,因为重复输入可增强模型的上下文理解。 我们的方法是对Echo Mean的补充,并进一步改善其业绩。
在8 192个上下文中,Echo Mean一般未能产生业绩改进,可能是因为上下文变得过长。
与此相反,我们的方法在这一背景下取得了更大的收益,这可能是因为随着语境长度的增加,有选择地保存显著的语义信息变得越来越重要.

blocks.en: Notably, compared with the substantial runtime overhead incurred by Echo’s input repetition, our method remains lightweight and introduces only a marginal additional runtime cost.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,与Echo重复投入引起的大量运行时间间接费用相比,我们的方法仍然轻而易举,只增加了少量运行时间成本。

blocks.en: Table 3: Ablation study results on Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 with an 8,192-token context length.
blocks.zh: 表3:米斯特拉尔-7B-Instruct-v0.3的沉积研究结果,上下文长度为8,192根.

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.4 阅读研究

blocks.en: We conduct ablation studies to investigate the effects of key design choices in SCSP, as shown in Table 3 .
blocks.zh: 如表3所示,我们进行开发研究,调查短链氯化石蜡关键设计选择的影响。

blocks.en:
We investigate the effect of input construction on performance.
First, we replace the sentence-aware semantic chunking strategy with fixed-length chunking.
This variant leads to an average performance drop of 1.01%, demonstrating that sentence-level chunking better preserves semantic coherence and facilitates effective token selection.
Second, instead of appending a semantic compression prompt to each chunk, we append a single prompt to the end of the entire long text for token selection.
This modification results in a performance drop of 2.73%, highlighting the importance of performing token selection within localized chunk-level contexts.
This may be because the input text is excessively long and attention scores are influenced by the relative distances between tokens.
Finally, we ablate the prompt and directly use the attention scores from the final token of each chunk to the preceding tokens for token selection.
The performance decreases by 4.77%, indicating that using semantic compression prompts to select tokens is a more effective strategy.
blocks.zh:
我们调查投入建设对业绩的影响。
首先,我们用固定长度的块法来取代句子感知语义的块法。
这一变体导致平均性能下降1.01%,表明句子级块能更好地保持语义一致性并促进有效的符号选择.
其次,我们不在每个块上附加一个语义压缩提示,而是将一个提示附加到整个长文本的结尾,以进行符号选择。
这一修改导致2.73%的性能下降,突出了在局部块级环境中进行符号选择的重要性。
这可能是因为输入文本过长,注意力分数受符号间相对距离的影响.
最后,我们将迅速和直接地使用每个块的最后符号的注意分数,到前面的符号来选择符号。
性能下降4.77%,表明使用语义压缩提示来选择令牌是一种更有效的策略.

blocks.en:
We investigate the effect of prompt isolation and position encoding on performance.
First, we retain the original causal attention pattern without modifying the attention mask, which results in a 3.49% performance decrease.
This finding indicates that allowing tokens to attend to the additionally appended prompts interferes with their representations and consequently degrades the quality of long-context embeddings.
Second, we explore modifying the positional encodings to keep the position indices of all document tokens contiguous, which results in a 0.35% performance drop.
This may be because retaining the positional gaps introduced by the inserted prompts helps the model better distinguish and capture semantic information within each chunk.
blocks.zh:
我们调查迅速隔离和定位编码对性能的影响。
首先,我们保留原因果关注模式,而不修改关注面罩,结果性能下降3.49%.
这一调查结果表明,允许信物处理附加的提示会干扰其表示,从而降低长文字嵌入的质量。
其次,我们探索修改位置编码,以保持所有文档符号的位置指数毗连,结果性能下降0.35%.
这可能是因为保留插入的提示所引入的位置空白有助于模型在每个块内更好地区分和捕捉语义信息.

blocks.en:
We further investigate token selection strategies and aggregation methods. First, we randomly select the same number of tokens within each chunk. The performance is close to that of Vanilla Mean, indicating that the gains of our method do not simply come from aggregating fewer tokens, but from identifying tokens that capture the core semantics of long documents.
Second, we directly aggregate the representation of the final token in the semantic compression prompt for each chunk, which serves as the compressed semantic representation of that chunk. This modification leads to a 5.02% performance drop.
Consistent with the findings of HTP ( Ding et al., 2026 ) , this result suggests that aggregating token-level representations is more effective than directly aggregating compressed prompt representations.
Finally, we use the token importance scores as weights to perform weighted aggregation of token representations.
We observe no further improvement over SCSP, suggesting that token importance scores are effective for token selection but are less suitable as weights for representation aggregation.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步调查象征性的选择战略和汇总方法。 首先,我们随机选择每个块中相同的符号数量. 其性能接近于香草梅因,表明我们方法的收益不仅来自汇总的代号较少,还来自识别能够捕捉长文件核心语义的代号.
第二,我们直接汇总每个块的语义压缩提示中最后符号的表示,它作为块的压缩语义表示. 这一修改导致5.02%的性能下降.
与HTP(Ding等人,2026年)的结论一致,这一结果表明,汇总象征性的表示比直接汇总压缩的即时表示更为有效。
最后,我们以象征性重要性分数作为加权数,对象征性表示进行加权汇总。
我们观察到与SCSP相比没有进一步的改进,这表明象征性重要性分数对于象征性选择是有效的,而对于代表汇总而言则不太合适。

blocks.en: 4.5 Generalizability across Different Context Lengths
blocks.zh: 4.5 不同背景的可概括性

blocks.en:
We further investigate the effect of different context lengths in Figure 2 (a).
First, our method consistently improves the performance of both baseline methods across multiple context lengths, demonstrating its effectiveness. Second, larger context lengths generally lead to better performance. However, the performance gains gradually diminish as the context window increases.
Notably, at a context length of 16,384, Vanilla Mean achieves further performance improvements on SumFD and NQA, suggesting that these two datasets benefit from a larger context window.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步调查图2(a)中不同背景长度的影响。
第一,我们的方法不断改进两种基线方法在多个背景长度上的性能,显示了其有效性。 第二,更大的上下文长度一般会导致更好的性能. 然而,随着上下文窗口的增加,业绩收益逐渐减少。
值得注意的是,在16 384个上下文长度中,Vanilla Mean进一步改进了SumFD和NQA的性能,表明这两个数据集得益于更大的上下文窗口。

blocks.en: 4.6 Effects of Hyperparameters
blocks.zh: 4.6 超参数的影响

blocks.en:
We further investigate the effects of different hyperparameters in Figure 2 (b), 2 (c), and 2 (d).
Our method consistently improves the performance of both Vanilla Mean and HTP across a wide range of hyperparameter settings, demonstrating its effectiveness and robustness.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步调查图2(b)、2(c)和2(d)中不同超参数的影响。
我们的方法在广泛的超参数设置中不断改进了香草Mean和HTP的性能,显示了其有效性和稳健性.

blocks.en:
For chunk size , Vanilla Mean achieves its best performance with a chunk size of 1,024, whereas HTP performs best with a chunk size of 2,048.
This suggests that the optimal chunk size varies across baselines, although our method yields consistent improvements for both.
For the ratio , Vanilla Mean achieves the best performance at 1.75, while HTP performs best at 2.5.
One possible explanation is that the token representations used by HTP incorporate more global semantic information and are therefore more contextualized, allowing a higher selection threshold to be applied.
Notably, under their respective best-performing configurations, SCSP retains only 14.03% of the tokens for Vanilla Mean and 8.64% for HTP. This result indicates that aggregating representations from a small subset of informative tokens is sufficient to construct effective long-context embeddings.
For the output layer , the best performance is obtained at the sixth-to-last layer, after which the performance gradually decreases as the output layer moves closer to the final layer.
blocks.zh:
就块大小而言,香草梅因的块大小达到1 024的最好成绩,而HTP的块大小达到2 048的最好成绩。
这表明,最佳块大小因基线而异,尽管我们的方法对两者都产生一致的改进。
就比例而言,香草梅因在1.75方面表现最佳,而HTP在2.5方面表现最佳。
一种可能的解释是,HTP所使用的符号表示包含更多的全球语义信息,因此更贴近背景,从而可以适用更高的选择门槛.
值得注意的是,根据各自的最佳配置,SCSP只保留了香草棉的14.03%和HTP的8.64%。 这一结果表明,汇总一小批信息符号的表述足以构建有效的长文嵌入。
对于输出层,最佳性能在第六层至最后一层获得,之后,随着输出层向最后层移动,性能逐渐下降.

blocks.en: 4.7 Generalization across Different Backbones
blocks.zh: 4.7 跨越不同背骨的概括

blocks.en: We further report the performance of vanilla mean on Gemma2-9B ( Team, 2024a ) and Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct ( Team, 2024b ) to validate the generalizability of our method across different backbones.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步报告Gemma2-9B(Team,2024a)和Quen-2.5-7B-Instruct(Team,2024b)上的香草平均性能,以验证我们的方法在不同骨干之间的通用性.

blocks.en:
Experimental results in Table 4 show that our method is also effective on these two LLMs, further demonstrating its generalizability.
Among the four LLMs, Gemma2-9B achieves the best performance with Vanilla Mean at a context length of 8,192.
blocks.zh:
表4中的实验结果显示,我们的方法对这两种有限责任公司也有效,进一步证明了其普遍性。
在四个LLM中,Gemma2-9B以8,192的上下文长度与Vanilla Mean取得了最佳的性能.

blocks.en: Table 5: Comparison of different strategies for computing token importance scores on Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 with an 8,192-token context length.
blocks.zh: 表5:对Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3上不同计算符号重要性策略的比较,上下文长度为8,192-token.

blocks.en: Table 6: Generalization of SCSP to fine-tuned embedding models on five datasets with an 8,192-token context length.
blocks.zh: 表6 SCSP的通用化,在5个数据集上微调嵌入模型,上下文长度为8,192根.

blocks.en: 4.8 Effects of Token Importance Scores
blocks.zh: 4.8 重要分数的影响

blocks.en:
We further investigate the effect of different strategies for computing token importance scores in Table 5 . All four strategies improve performance, with taking the maximum across all layers and attention heads achieving the best results, while averaging across all layers and heads performs the worst.
This suggests that the max operation is more effective at uncovering salient semantic signals captured by individual layers or attention heads, whereas mean aggregation may smooth out such informative signals.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步调查表5中计算象征性重要性分数的不同策略的影响。 所有这四项战略都改进了业绩,在各个层面尽最大可能,注意力集中在头,取得最佳成果,而在所有层面平均,头顶表现最差。
这表明,最大操作在发现单个层或注意力头所捕获的显著语义信号方面更为有效,而平均聚合则可能平滑出这种信息信号。

blocks.en: 4.9 Results on Finetuned Embedding Models
blocks.zh: 4.9 关于精细嵌入模型的结果

blocks.en:
We further investigate whether our method is also effective for fine-tuned embedding models in Table 6 .
Specifically, we replace their mean pooling operation with our selective pooling method and use the final-layer representations to construct the embeddings.
The results show that our method consistently improves the performance of both GritLM ( Muennighoff et al., 2025 ) and NV-EMBED ( Lee et al., 2025 ) .
Notably, NV-EMBED employs latent attention to update each token representation.
This suggests that semantically irrelevant tokens remain unable to capture useful semantic information even after latent-attention refinement.
These results demonstrate that our method is effective not only for general-purpose LLMs but also for further improving fine-tuned embedding models, highlighting its generalizability.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步调查我们的方法是否对表6中的精细嵌入模型也有效。
具体地说,我们用我们选择性的集合方法来取代他们的集成操作,并使用最终层的表述来构建嵌入.
结果显示,我们的方法不断改善GritLM(Muennighoff等人,2025年)和NV-EMBED(Lee等人,2025年)的性能。
值得注意的是,NV-EMBED利用潜在注意力来更新每个象征性的表示.
这表明,即使对潜在意向进行了改进,仍然无法收集有用的语义信息。
这些结果表明,我们的方法不仅对一般用途的有限责任方案有效,而且对进一步改进精细调整的嵌入模型有效,突出了其普遍性。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduced SCSP, a training-free framework for constructing long-context embeddings through semantic compression-guided selective pooling.
SCSP first partitions a long document into sentence-aware chunks and appends a semantic compression prompt to each chunk to estimate token importance.
A prompt-isolated attention mask prevents the inserted prompts from interfering with the original document representations, while the resulting attention patterns are used to identify and selectively aggregate semantically informative tokens.
Extensive experiments demonstrate that SCSP consistently improves Vanilla Mean, Echo Mean, and HTP across different context lengths and LLM backbones.
Moreover, SCSP also enhances finetuned embedding models, demonstrating its broad applicability.
These results highlight selective token aggregation as an effective alternative to conventional mean pooling.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们引入了SCSP,这是一个通过语义压缩制导选择性集合构建长文本嵌入的无培训框架.
SCSP首先将一个长的文档分割成句子感知块,并附加一个语义压缩提示到每个块,以估计符号重要性.
即时同化的注意罩防止插入的提示干扰原始文件的表示,而由此产生的注意模式则用于识别和选择性地汇总内容丰富的符号.
广泛的实验表明,SCSP在不同的上下文长度和LLM主干线上不断改进Vanilla Mean, Echo Mean和HTP.
此外,SCSP还加强了精细嵌入模型,显示了其广泛的适用性.
这些结果突出了选择性符号汇总作为常规平均集合的有效替代办法。

blocks.zh: 附录A 语义压缩提示的效果

blocks.en: We investigate the effects of different prompts on performance in Table 7 .
blocks.zh: 我们调查表7中不同提示对业绩的影响。

blocks.en:
All evaluated prompts yield performance improvements, indicating that our method generalizes well across different prompts and exhibits broad applicability.
We further remove the opening quotation mark from the prompt and observe a performance decrease of 0.77%.
This finding suggests that the opening quotation mark provides a more effective cue for eliciting the desired semantic continuation.
blocks.zh:
所有评价都促使业绩得到改善,表明我们的方法广泛适用于不同的评价,并广泛适用。
我们进一步从提示中去掉开头的引号,并观察到性能下降0.77%.
这一结论表明,开头的引号为引导期望的语义延续提供了更有效的提示.

blocks.en: Appendix B Results on the LOCOV1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 附录B LOCOV1数据集的结果

blocks.en: We further evaluate our method on the LOCOV1 dataset ( Saad-Falcon et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评价我们在LOCOV1数据集上的方法(Saad-Falcon等人,2024年)。

blocks.en:
SCSP consistently improves Vanilla Mean across all eight datasets, increasing the average score from 55.77 to 60.77, with an absolute gain of 5.00 points.
The improvements are particularly pronounced on SumFD and QASPER Title, where SCSP yields gains of 12.56 and 9.13 points, respectively.
Consistent gains are also observed across QA, retrieval, and long-document understanding tasks, indicating that selective aggregation can effectively suppress less informative tokens and produce more discriminative long-context representations.
blocks.zh:
SCSP在所有8个数据集中持续改善Vanilla Mean,平均得分从55.77提高到60.77,绝对得分5.00.
这些改进在SumFD和QASPER标题上特别突出,SCSP的增益分别为12.56分和9.13分.
在质量保证、检索和长文件理解任务中也看到持续的进展,表明有选择的汇总可以有效地压制信息较少的标志,并产生更歧视性的长文表述。
